Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome: Radiographs show multiple well-defined radio-opaque lesions consistent with phleboliths
Sluggish flow within lesion seen during Valsalva maneuver, suggestive of dilated torturous venous channels
MRI shows multiple dilated veins in superficial aspect of right upper limb
Swollen areas are soft, compressible, and reduce in size when elevated
Symptoms worsen when limb is lowered
bones of forearm and hand are underdeveloped and tender
